crossRefs.note: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,
For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies…
For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be…
Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

translations.web: “Yahweh’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.
translations.bsb: The Spirit of the LORD spoke through me; His word was on my tongue.
translations.kjv: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.
translations.asv: The Spirit of Jehovah spake by me, And his word was upon my tongue.
